body.statement: Conditional on the effective-compatible-density theorem, for every \(\mathfrak G\in\mathfrak E\) and rational \(\varepsilon>0\), \(\operatorname{CertGluePFL}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\) terminates and returns a replayable globally honest primal rule, a finite rational atomic dual, outward rational endpoints \(L_{\varepsilon}\le M_{\mathfrak G,\eta}(r)\le U_{\varepsilon}\) with \(U_{\varepsilon}-L_{\varepsilon}\le\varepsilon\), and explicit total recursive bounds \(N_{\mathrm{glue}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), \(N_{\mathrm{cut}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), \(N_{\mathrm{Gauss}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), \(N_{\mathrm{LP}}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\), and \(\operatorname{Bit}(\mathfrak G,\varepsilon)\) recorded in \(\mathsf C\).
body.justification: A convergence theorem without a finite stopping recurrence would not support certified statistical practice.
body.gap: Jones and Peet give an a priori integration error, Jungen, Djelassi, and Mitsos give conditional convergence for finite-dimensional semi-infinite programs, and Cousins and Vempala give randomized Gaussian-volume approximation; none certifies this function-valued minimax game with exact honesty and a matched atomic dual.
body.consumer: For the Job Corps assertion list, the output archives the exact observed-cell-to-\(\mathfrak G_0\) encoding, the simultaneous honest label rule, the primal and atomic-dual objects, and every outward integration and repair charge; this replayable certificate is required because a floating-point optimizer cannot establish global honesty on tied capacity, sign, or cross-quantile faces.

obligation.what_is_open: Give total recursive stopping bounds for the unbounded primal search, every weighted Gaussian supremum, cut generation, dual enumeration, and bit precision.
obligation.obstruction: Atomic dual convergence and exact coverage repair are now proved, but qualitative candidate density does not identify a finite stage at which all unbounded ledger suprema have outward enclosures and the primal--dual gap is below the requested tolerance.
obligation.attempted: Finite rational gridding, active-set linear programming, Gaussian truncation, full-set repair, and dovetailed atomic enumeration close each fixed bounded subproblem. They do not supply the missing global stopping recurrence.
obligation.partial_result:
If \(\widetilde K\) has coverage at least \(1-\eta-\rho\), put \(q=\rho/(\eta+\rho)\) and report \(V\) with probability \(q\).  Then
\[
 q+(1-q)(1-\eta-\rho)=1-\eta,
\]
and the risk increases by at most \(Dq=D\rho/(\eta+\rho)\).  The proved atomic-duality theorem supplies sound lower certificates converging to the minimax value.  A complete recursive stage at which all unbounded weighted suprema and the primal--dual gap are simultaneously certified is still missing.
